description: Create a new Report Manager report.

examples.user_query: Create a new report named 'Weekly Sales Report' with PDF and CSV formats enabled, and set it to overwrite existing files on the file share.

examples.user_query: How can I create a report for monthly performance metrics with email notifications enabled?
examples.notes: This call creates a report named 'Monthly Performance Metrics' with PDF and URL formats enabled. It also sets up email notifications for the report.

examples.user_query: Set up a report for quarterly revenue analysis with a specific template and high priority.
examples.notes: This call creates a report named 'Quarterly Revenue Analysis' using a specific template and assigns it a high priority.

description: Delete a Report Manager report by id.

examples.notes: This call deletes the report with the specified ID. Use it when you need to remove a specific report from the Report Manager.

examples.user_query: How do I remove a report with the ID 'monthly_sales_2023'?
examples.notes: This example demonstrates how to delete a report with a specific ID, such as 'monthly_sales_2023'. Use this when you no longer need the report.

examples.user_query: Can you delete the report identified as 'temp_report_001'?

description: Retrieve a single Report Manager report by id.

owner_info.description: When ``True``, include the report owner's information. Default is ``False``.

recipients_info.description: When ``True``, include recipient data. Default is ``False``.

dashboards_info.description: When ``True``, include dashboard names. Default is ``False``.

fields.description: Whitelist of fields to return. Fields can also be excluded by prefixing their name with ``-``.

examples.user_query: Retrieve the report with ID 'report123' and include recipient data.
examples.notes: Fetches the report with the specified ID and includes recipient information in the response.

examples.user_query: Can you get the report with ID 'sales_report_2023' and include the owner's details?
examples.notes: Retrieves the report with the given ID and includes the owner's information in the response.

examples.user_query: Fetch the report with ID 'dashboard_report_456' and include dashboard names.
examples.notes: Retrieves the report with the specified ID and includes the names of associated dashboards in the response.

description: Retrieve all reports configured in Report Manager.

ids.description: One or more report ids to filter by. A bare string is treated as a single id.

enabled.description: When provided, filter to only enabled (``True``) or disabled (``False``) reports.

statuses.description: One or more running statuses to filter by. A bare string is treated as a single status.

priority.description: Filter reports by priority. One of ``"high"``, ``"normal"``.

owner_ids.description: One or more owner user ids to filter by. A bare string is treated as a single id.

fields.description: Whitelist of fields to return for each report. Fields can also be excluded by prefixing their name with ``-``.

sort.description: Field to sort results by. Ascending by default, descending if prefixed with ``-``.

limit.description: Page size used for the underlying paginated requests. Default is ``100``.

examples.user_query: Retrieve all enabled reports owned by user ID 'user123'.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all reports that are enabled and owned by the specified user. Use this to filter reports by ownership and status.

examples.user_query: What reports are currently running with high priority?
examples.notes: This call filters reports to only those with a 'running' status and 'high' priority. Use this to monitor urgent tasks.

examples.user_query: Show all reports sorted by name, but only return the 'name' and 'status' fields.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all reports, sorted alphabetically by name, and limits the returned fields to 'name' and 'status'. Use this for simplified report listings.

examples.user_query: Run the report with ID 'sales_report_2023' immediately.
examples.notes: This call triggers an immediate execution of the 'sales_report_2023' report. If the server is at capacity, the report will be queued.

examples.user_query: How can I execute the report with ID 'customer_retention_q4'?
examples.notes: Use this call to run the 'customer_retention_q4' report. It ensures the report is executed or queued if the server is busy.

examples.user_query: I need to trigger the 'inventory_audit_2023' report right now.
examples.notes: This example demonstrates running the 'inventory_audit_2023' report immediately. Useful for time-sensitive reporting tasks.

description: Update an existing Report Manager report.

examples.user_query: Update the report with ID 'report123' to enable it and set its priority to high.
examples.notes: This call updates the specified report to enable it and set its priority to high. Use this when you need to modify key attributes of an existing report.

examples.user_query: How can I update the schedule and recipients for a report?
examples.notes: This call updates the schedule and recipients for the specified report. Use this when you need to adjust the timing and audience of a report.

examples.user_query: Can I change the report type and overwrite existing files in the file share?
examples.notes: This call updates the report type and ensures that files in the file share are overwritten upon completion. Use this when changing the output format and managing file storage behavior.
